title: Plain-Text Cognitive Architecture for Claude Code (HN Show HN)
description: HN 'Show HN' post presenting a plain-text cognitive architecture pattern for Claude Code. Core idea: memory is organized as 'directed' (purpose-driven) rather than as logs or free-form notes. Structured answers serve as memories — each memory entry is a Q&A pair where the question defines the retrieval context and the answer is the retained knowledge. Claims to reduce hallucination in long agentic runs by grounding memory in explicit query-answer structure rather than narrative summaries.
preliminary_notes: Existing memory system uses MEMORY.md index + per-topic .md files with frontmatter (name/description/type). This technique proposes a different model: Q&A pairs as the primary memory unit. If the 'directed' (query-first) structure offers meaningfully better retrieval in practice, it could improve memory access patterns. Needs: (1) source URL verification (HN link may be behind paywall or link-only), (2) comparison to existing memory system, (3) check if it's just reformatting our existing approach or a structurally different model.
